# A 100.00 USD bill settled out of the claim prepaid to that supplier.
#
# `from_credit: true` says the money is the vendor's own claim rather than a
# bank payment, and the two guids give the split it comes out of. Spending it
# takes its `cost_basis_balance` off — because the currency was spent, which
# says nothing about how much of it had been sold beforehand.
#
# TXN_GUID and SPLIT_GUID are filled in by the test from the book.
bill "BILL-SPENDS-IT"
	vendor_id: "V-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-03-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-01
		description: "Supplies"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-01
		due: 2026-04-01
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
		memo: "BILL-SPENDS-IT"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		amount: 100.00
		from_credit: true
		credit_dated: 2026-02-01
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		txn_split_guid: "SPLIT_GUID"
